direction: Support-aware selective OOD probabilistic forecasting for unseen stations/cities
core_scientific_question: When is a new station inside the learned support, and how should the model predict, abstain or fall back when it is not?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: High in generic OOD/conformal methods; moderate in EV-specific strict zero-shot risk semantics
method_space: station archetype encoder + analog retrieval + support-overlap score + trajectory calibration + risk-linked abstention
go_no_go_test: Leave-one-city/station-out baselines must show material coverage collapse; support score must predict failure and selective fallback must lower tail operational risk.

direction: Censoring-aware latent demand, served power and lost-demand joint forecasting
core_scientific_question: How much demand is hidden by occupied/faulty chargers, queues and competing stations, and can it be bounded from operational records?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Basic censored regression and queue conversion are occupied; real-data partial identification remains less settled
method_space: multi-cause censoring graph + partial-identification bounds + spatial substitution/queue model + joint probabilistic outputs
primary_data: UrbanEV/Beijing transaction data + capacity/occupancy; semi-synthetic or mobility augmentation
go_no_go_test: A credible censoring indicator/instrument or validated semi-synthetic truth must exist; otherwise latent demand is not identifiable and the track stops.

direction: Cold-start charging-station forecasting by archetype retrieval and in-context adaptation
core_scientific_question: Which existing stations are valid analogs for a new site with zero or few observations?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Few-shot transfer, VisionEV and generic in-context/retrieval methods exist
method_space: retrieval over static/site descriptors and short traces + foundation/backbone adaptation + unsupported-site rejection
go_no_go_test: Strict zero-history, unlabeled, 1/7/14-day protocols; retrieval must beat global TSFM/transfer baselines without target-label leakage.

direction: Learning-augmented robust charging scheduling with untrusted forecasts
core_scientific_question: Can scheduling approach oracle performance when forecasts are good while retaining a worst-case safety guarantee when they fail?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Decision-focused EV control and generic learning-augmented scheduling/CP-in-loop exist
method_space: forecast-as-advice controller with consistency/robustness/smoothness guarantees and safe baseline fallback
primary_data: ACN-Sim or EV2Gym; later real sessions
go_no_go_test: Oracle value must be nontrivial; method must dominate safe baseline under accurate forecasts and remain bounded under adversarial errors.

core_scientific_question: How will demand change under a price or control policy not represented in historical operation?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Real causal incentive studies and pricing games exist; portable forecasting is less established
method_space: causal representation + treatment-effect heterogeneity + policy-conditioned generative forecast + overlap diagnostics
primary_data: Requires intervention/pilot data; public data likely insufficient
go_no_go_test: Must obtain treatment variation and overlap sufficient for identification; simulated prices alone are not acceptable evidence.

direction: Mixed-type hierarchical forecasting of sessions, occupancy, duration, energy and power
core_scientific_question: Can discrete events and continuous load variables remain coherent across station–zone–city levels?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: EV multi-task forecasting and generic mixed-type reconciliation already exist
method_space: mixed distribution heads + service-flow constraints + hierarchical reconciliation + OOD calibration
primary_data: UrbanEV/CHARGED; session datasets for event variables
go_no_go_test: Coherence must improve calibration/operational utility, not only satisfy algebraic sums.

direction: Trustworthy federated OOD forecasting with heterogeneous local models
core_scientific_question: How can clients with different architectures, schemas and shifts share knowledge while preserving calibrated uncertainty and resisting privacy/poisoning risks?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: FedMixer, Fed-TREND, PiXTime, FedProC and federated conformal substantially crowd the space
method_space: explicit threat model + heterogeneous knowledge object + temporal joint-shift calibration + client support/reliability gating
primary_data: CHARGED federated simulation; external client domains
recommended_role: Project integration after central method is proven
go_no_go_test: Must define attack/privacy/calibration targets and outperform centralized/local/heterogeneous-FL baselines under the same client protocols.

direction: Foundation model or diffusion backbone replacement
core_scientific_question: Can a larger generic model improve charging forecasts?
nearest_prior_art_pressure: Very high: VisionEV, EV-STLLM, DiffCharge, DiffPLF, UniTS and retrieval diffusion
method_space: Mostly component-level unless tied to a new problem/guarantee
go_no_go_test: Do not proceed as a standalone direction.
